text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has instructed government ministries to take steps to help flood victims in southern Vietnam.
-- Latest monthly inflation figures show a rise of 0.1 percent from September, bringing cumulative inflation over the past 10 months to 2.6 percent.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has announced measures aimed at increasing budget revenue, which had reached only 62.3 percent of the 1996 target by the end of September.
-- A three-month course on State management for provincial officials ended last week.

-- The Ministry for Planning and Investment has withdrawn an investment licence for a big hotel and business complex joint-venture in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. The report said the Swiss partner in the venture, Noga Saigon, had failed to meet its financial commitments.
